description: Breaking Fantasy Football player news along with the impact for fantasy managers

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The 49ers signed WR KhaDarel Hodge.
items.impact: Hodge appeared in 12 games with the Falcons last season. He will compete for a depth role in the wide receiver room for San Francisco.
items.title: KhaDarel Hodge signs with 49ers

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Rashee Rice was able to progress to taking part in 11-on-11 drills at practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: Rice has been recovering from arthroscopic surgery on his right knee in May. He was able to participate in 11-on-11 drills for the first time in camp as he continues to progress in the right direction.
items.title: Rashee Rice (knee) takes part in 11-on-11 drills Wednesday

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Cardinals coach Mike LaFleur told reporters that rookie RB Jeremiyah Love will not play in the Hall of Fame game on Thursday against the Panthers.
items.impact: We will have to wait a little longer to see the star rookie play. Love should see some action in the other three preseason games.
items.title: Jeremiyah Love will not play in Hall of Fame game Thursday

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Packers OC Adam Stenavich told reporters he is hopeful Tucker Kraft will be good to go for Week 1.
items.impact: Kraft is expected to participate in a joint practice later in August. His status will need to continue to be monitored in training camp over the next few weeks.
items.title: Tucker Kraft (knee) hopeful for Week 1 per Packers OC

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Packers OC Adam Stenavich confirmed that MarShawn Lloyd will play in the preseason.
items.impact: Stenavich said every day Lloyd is able to practice, he gets more confident his injury issues are fully behind him. He is competing the backup role in the Packers backfield.
items.title: MarShawn Lloyd will play in preseason

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Courtland Sutton was not in uniform at practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: Sutton also did not practice on Wednesday. It is unclear if he is dealing with any injury or just getting a couple of load management days off. There should be an update provided on his status when available.
items.title: Courtland Sutton not in uniform at practice Wednesday

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Christen Miller was limited in practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: Miller is battling a toe injury. He was still able to practice in limited fashion.
items.title: Christen Miller (toe) limited in practice Wednesday

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Kendre Miller was limited in practice at Saints training camp on Wednesday.
items.impact: Miller is managing a back injury. He continues to compete for the RB3 role in the Saints backfield behind Travis Etienne and Alvin Kamara.
items.title: Kendre Miller (back) limited in practice Wednesday

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Nik Bonitto did not practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: Bonitto was at Broncos practice, but he didn't participate. He avoided a serious leg injury in practice earlier this week.
items.title: Nik Bonitto (leg) does not practice Wednesday

items.author: Garrett Ball
items.desc: Tank Dell will participate in the padded portion of practice on Wednesday for the first time since his injury.
items.impact: It's a big step for Dell, who is working his way back from the awful injury he sustained in 2024. Hopefully everything goes well and fantasy managers continue to see him build confidence and value.
items.title: Tank Dell to participate in padded practice on Wednesday

items.author: Garrett Ball
items.desc: Jalon Walker is confirmed to have torn his ACL during the Falcons' Tuesday practice.
items.impact: Walker will now miss out on the entire 2026 season. For now, Azeez Ojulari stands to benefit from Walker's absence in the starting rotation. But another name could emerge as camp rolls on.
items.title: Jalon Walker confirmed to have torn ACL

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The Texans signed WR Montrell Washington.
items.impact: Washington had a successful workout for Houston. He will compete for a depth role in its wide receiver room and on special teams.
items.title: Montrell Washington signs with Texans

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: DJ Giddens did not practice on Tuesday due to a hamstring injury.
items.impact: Giddens is competing for a depth role in the Colts backfield.
items.title: DJ Giddens (hamstring) misses practice Tuesday

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Xavier Legette will not play in the Hall of Fame game on Thursday against the Cardinals.
items.impact: Legette left practice early on Tuesday, but he was cleared for a concussion. He did suffer a stinger.
items.title: Xavier Legette will not play in Hall of Fame game Thursday

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Dolphins OC Bobby Slowik labeled Chris Bell as "still a long ways away."
items.impact: Bell opened training camp on the non-football injury list. He is working his way back from a torn ACL.
items.title: Chris Bell (knee) 'long ways' from returning

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The Commanders signed CB Fabian Moreau.
items.impact: Moreau was previously drafted by Washington in 2017. He was on the Vikings practice squad last season.
items.title: Fabian Moreau signs with Commanders

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The Seahawks waived WR Kyre Duplessis.
items.impact: Duplessis signed with Seattle last week. He will figure to seek another opportunity during training camp.
items.title: Kyre Duplessis waived by Seahawks

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The Seahawks signed LB Garrett Nelson.
items.impact: Nelson spent time on practice squads in both Denver and New Orleans last season. He will compete for a depth role in the Seahawks linebacker room.
items.title: Garrett Nelson signs with Seahawks

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The Browns waived OT Jack Conley.
items.impact: Conley will figure to seek another opportunity during training camp.
items.title: Jack Conley waived by Browns

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The Browns signed CB Tyler Hall.
items.impact: Hall appeared in one game with the Seahawks last season. He will compete for a depth role in the Browns secondary.
items.title: Tyler Hall signs with Browns

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The Texans placed wide receiver DJ Turner on injured reserve with an undisclosed injury.
items.impact: Turner signed with the Texans on July 29 and practiced Monday. His season will end on injured reserve, or the Texans will reach an injury settlement with him and release him.
items.title: DJ Turner placed on IR

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Cowboys TE Princeton Fant has a torn ACL and partial MCL tear.
items.impact: It is a brutal break for Fant who suffered the injury during practice. He is expected to undergo surgery in the next couple of weeks.
items.title: Princeton Fant suffers torn ACL

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The Patriots released TE Jeremiah Franklin.
items.impact: Franklin will figure to seek another opportunity during training camp.
items.title: Jeremiah Franklin released by Patriots

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The Patriots claimed WR Tejhaun Palmer off waivers.
items.impact: Palmer was waived by the Cardinals. He Will compete for a depth role in the Patriots wide receiver room.
items.title: Tejhaun Palmer claimed off waivers by Patriots

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The Panthers have placed DL LaBryan Ray on the reserve/retired list.
items.impact: Ray played 46 games the past three seasons, including 10 starts. He was not at practice on Tuesday for personal reasons.
items.title: LaBryan Ray retires from NFL

title: Fantasy Player News
